name: bookie
description: A house sportsbook run by a bookie NPC (`flags.bookie`). `odds` shows the line on each sports game on the air, priced off the league table with a house margin; `punt <amount> <team>` backs a side to win at those decimal odds while the book is open (the first few minutes of an airing); `slips` lists open bets. Slips live in `bookie_bets` and a one-minute sweep pays them at the final.
